name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && cross-env FLASK_DEBUG=true uv run python run.py
scripts.start:backend: cd backend && uv run waitress-serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=5001 --threads=8 --channel-timeout=600 wsgi:app
